ValueSet-AttributeType.narrative: This schema validates IRI-formatted codes for the AttributeType for a Product ValueSet. Each enum value includes the system URI in the format {systemuri}#{code} to match JSON-LD enumeration IRIs. Display values are available at http://smart.who.int/pcmt/ValueSet-AttributeType.displays.json. For a complete listing of all ValueSets, see artifacts.html#terminology-value-sets.
